attacks.name: Rocksteady Guardian - Echo Skill
expressions:
Transform into Rocksteady Guardian and enter a Parry State. Upon being attacked, deal Spectro DMG equal to 5.18% of the Resonator's Max HP, and perform a follow-up attack that deals Spectro DMG equal to 5.18% of the Resonator's Max HP.
Use the Echo Skill again to exit the transformation.
If the attack received is a Special Skill attack, interrupt the enemy's Special Skill, gain a Shield equal to 30% Max HP, and perform a two-stage follow-up attack, each dealing Spectro DMG equal to 3.45% of the Resonator's Max HP. These follow-up attacks simultaneously launch three ground-breaking waves, each dealing Spectro DMG equal to 2.87% of the Resonator's Max HP.
CD: 15s
